description: A cache schema fault (F2), then a second advance of the SAME key the moment a repair is proposed for it. The proposal rests on a version that no longer exists.
prerequisites: The catalog cache holds entries stored under the baseline schema.

steps.note: fires on NOTIFY nemodots_action_proposed naming cache.schema_version

symptoms: the first repair proposal is rejected or invalidated by the second advance
oracle.notes: Honest outcomes: blocked(stale_version) at admission/commit, or a commit followed by a second invalidation and repair. If the dependent step never fires (no proposal names the key) it is skipped.
